title: Countable uniformly discrete sets in functionally balanced groups
summary: We prove that every countable left uniformly discrete subset of a Hausdorff functionally balanced topological group is right thin. As applications, we answer two questions of Bouziad and Troallic: every left precompact subset of a Hausdorff functionally balanced group is right precompact, and every Hausdorff $ω$-narrow functionally balanced group is a SIN group.
